name: Soren
source:
Soren is the young heir of the influential Murano family that's based in the town of Oxhabor, one of the locations Raen visits on his journey.

He likes to keep a certain distance from others, and is usually seen in tinted eyeglasses to make himself feel more secure.

He's scared of something, but he can't say exactly what.

[Edited from the developer's [url=https://twitter.com/TwoHalfStudios/status/1134230363880939521/]official Twitter[/url]]
